properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Confirmed: @stablelib/x25519 1.0.3 declared in demo/package-lock.json as a dependency of @walletconnect/utils 2.17.0 (via @walletconnect/universal-provider, pulled by the wagmi/@ant-design/web3-wagmi WalletConnect connector). WalletConnect's relay protocol uses X25519 ECDH with ChaCha20-Poly1305 + HKDF-SHA256 for session key agreement — classical, retroactively breakable. The algorithm is fixed by the wallet-connect stack version; this repo can only change it by upgrading that dependency.
